name: RG202616
tagline: Traditional craftsmanship meets high-output central heating
description: A high-performance wood-burning cookstove designed to serve as the heart of the home. Hand-assembled in Serbia with a robust bolted construction, the Thermo Magnum Plus combines traditional cooking and baking capabilities with a powerful integrated water circuit for central heating. Featuring a large enameled oven with an integrated thermometer and a spacious cast iron cooktop, it provides both radiant warmth and practical utility for modern off-grid or energy-efficient living.
features: Integrated water boiler for central heating (up to 14kW output)
Large enameled oven with door-mounted thermometer
Durable cast iron firebox and cooktop frame
Primary, secondary, and oven damper controls for precision heat
Spacious bottom drawer for log storage or warming
